name: Shindou Mizuho
source:
Yoshiki's classmate and class chairman.

She is feared by the boys for her harsh language and behavior, but in fact she has a very girlish side. She secretly likes Yoshiki. She accidentally spies on the main character and Tomomi having sex in the classroom.
